scope: Read-only source/manual-operation audit; no production edits. Existing final851 compiler source pins match. Static coverage is not39executed end-to-end tests or production qualification; any separately executed NEW composed journey has its own receipt.

actions.action: Global PoPL pause / unpause
actions.caller: Governance; guardian can only set true; bootstrap before seal
actions.inputs: state=true stops live PoPL work; false clears this one flag. Nonpayable.
actions.read_before: Access.governance, guardians, paused, canonicalState, preparationActive, lpExitStarted; pending signer/receipt state
actions.requirements: Exact current authority. This setter itself does not require canonical-operating state; clearing pause never clears other locks.
actions.effect: Stops PoPL live entry/mint/harvest/compound/buyback/ordinary rebalance. Existing Uniswap LP remains in the pool and external swaps/active-range fee accrual continue. Claims/transfers retain their separate rules.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Reversible flag; does not reset clocks or reverse transactions. Resolve incident and journals before separately resuming scheduling.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Not a per-leg Uniswap pause. It does not cancel already-broadcast transactions. Outside ranges earn no swap fees while paused; accrued venue fees remain unharvested until an allowed harvest/close.

actions.action: Mint-only stop / restart
actions.inputs: state bool; nonpayable.
actions.read_before: mintPaused, randomnessConfigured, mintedCount, nextToFinalize, Access locks
actions.requirements: Not preparation/frozen/retired; pause allowed. Existing reveal/claims/transfers/LP work remain separate.
actions.effect: Stops new NFT mint requests without stopping existing LP.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Reversible; on-chain setting needs no service restart by itself.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Clearing mintPaused is insufficient if globally paused, sale lifetime/supply exhausted or randomness unqualified. It cannot repair/reroll an existing failed VRF request.

actions.action: Stop contributions or operations for one admitted pool
actions.inputs: poolId is admitted PoolKey hash. True flags disable that capability; false leaves unchanged. At least one true.
actions.read_before: get(poolId), contributionPool, Vault poolBucket/group, Balancer execution venues
actions.requirements: Known pool and canConfigure; no external price/token/venue read required for disabling.
actions.effect: deposits disables activation/top-ups and clears current contribution pointer. operations disables normal deployment/swaps/maintenance there; existing physical LP and claims are not withdrawn.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Re-enable via full configureNative validation, not disablePool(false,false). No service restart for the chain flag alone.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: It does not pause Uniswap trading. Raw collection/parking/residual close remain separate. Disabling an LP destination differs from removing that ID only from swap candidates.

actions.action: Admit/reconfigure/re-enable a same-pair pool; change range/cooldown/limits
actions.inputs: PoolConfig=(key,depositsEnabled,operationsEnabled,rangeBps,triggerBps,maxSpotDeviationBps,maxSlippageBps,minRebalanceInterval,minDepositUSD,maxPositionUSD); key=(currency0,currency1,fee,tickSpacing,hooks). See shared bounds.
actions.read_before: get/accounting and exact PoolKey/core slot0, native bindings/runtime pins, both priceBounds, Rewards.isAsset, contributionPool, existing NFT cumulative contributionUSD, reserved bucket
actions.requirements: NativeETH0/fixedZZZ1, static hookless admitted v4, exact immutable core bindings, qualified healthy prices and supported fee/ticks. Another enabled contribution pool must be disabled first. Post-terminal only Ready+deposits=false.
actions.effect: Writes reviewed parameters/flags and revision; geometry changes become pending, not instant LP trades. Re-enabling a source asset is separate.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Reconfigurable within bounds; existing physical LP not rewritten. No worker restart for compatible on-chain parameters, but source/config profiles must stay matched.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Full config overwrites all supplied fields: copy unchanged reviewed values, not defaults. Narrow bands can be tick-unrepresentable or inactive at permitted spot deviation and must reject. Stronger pool minimum can block $5 growth; maxPositionUSD caps cumulative per-NFT gross input, not current NAV or pool total.

actions.action: Reserve pool identity / permanent custody capacity
actions.inputs: Admitted pool ID and exact existing bucket, or correct canonical bucketIdentity for a new empty domain. No tokens/value.
actions.read_before: Vault.poolBucket(pool), bucketCount/MAX_BUCKETS, bucketAt/group; VaultCanonical.bucketIdentity(pool), alias mapping
actions.requirements: Before terminal exit, not preparation/frozen. Existing nonzero mapping cannot point to a different bucket.
actions.effect: Permanently registers one of4 bucket slots if new and binds pool alias. Reusing one existing bucket for future pools does not consume another slot.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Not undoable/reassignable; no cancellation refund. Simulate before signing.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Wrong arbitrary bucket or early target activation can irreversibly consume/misbind capacity. For a move, reserve target to existing source bucket BEFORE enabling target deposits. No arbitrary bucket-merging function exists.

actions.action: Move existing shared LP to another admitted nativeETH/fixedZZZ pool
actions.inputs: id=existing logical bucket, pool=reviewed new PoolKey hash, positive MAIN raw-L floor, deadline now..now+600.
actions.read_before: group/id/poolBucket target, both accounting configs, desired target mode/geometry, prices, captured budgets, venue list, main/residual backing
actions.requirements: Live/unpaused, operating, before terminal exit, Active source, different actual destination pool, same ordered pair, target operations enabled and reserved-compatible bucket.
actions.effect: Harvests/closes both legs, releases designated compound, rebalances/redeploys atomically and preserves NFT shares/rights. Target desired mode determines one/two new physical positions.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: A later guarded move can reverse venue choice; no transaction undo. Actual new LP clock anchors after success; reconcile pending/jitter.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Cannot move to WETH/differentZZZ/another chain. Does not itself enable new target contributions or fix incompatible source dependencies. If a guard fails old LP remains. Admission is not sufficient liquidity/depth qualification.

actions.action: Temporarily park the complete portfolio without swaps
actions.inputs: ParkingRequest shared tuple below. Raw minima cover both-leg returned principal, excluding preexisting idle. No external recipient.
actions.read_before: Full current Position/shares/pair, parkingNonce/custodyEpoch, Manager.executionPortfolioFingerprint(main), raw principal estimates
actions.requirements: Sealed, globally paused, Active, no terminal exit; ordinary canonical state. Unlike closeResidual, drain-governance permits parking during preparation.
actions.effect: Harvest both and close both into same bucket attributed idle; main/residual association cleared, Parked status. No swaps/USD source read.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Resume via Migration.resume while live/unpaused after validation; parking itself does not pay holders or cancel preparation.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Actual token/core/native binding and fee ledgers must work. At least one raw minimum positive. Shared parking nonce invalidates stale requests; stale identity or receipt minima revert atomically.

actions.action: Resume parked liquidity
actions.inputs: Logical Parked bucket; admitted same-pair target pool; positive MAIN raw-L minimum; fresh deadline.
actions.read_before: Parked group/idle, target pool reservation/config, prices/routes/budgets/mode; no live residual
actions.requirements: Live/unpaused, no preparation/canonical/terminal locks; Parked state and same ordered pair; target operations enabled.
actions.effect: Releases designated compound and guardedly redeploys idle into actual new main plus optional residual; retains shares.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Return to Active after successful atomic operation. Further park/move possible before terminal exit.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Unpause alone does not resume Parked LP. Loss/deployment/idle/active-main guards remain. Emergency can recover Parked bucket in its existing pool with explicit ticks; it does not select a new LP destination.

actions.action: Select desired single/hybrid mode without pausing
actions.inputs: Exact poolId, true hybrid or false single, nonzero review commitment; next must differ.
actions.read_before: enabled(pool), geometryRevision, appliedRevision(main), configurationPending(bucket), live association and main state
actions.requirements: Operating and before terminal exit; enabling validates pool; disabling does not require healthy old venue. Global pause allowed but unnecessary.
actions.effect: Records desired policy/revisions; creates/closes no LP immediately. Next successful cooldown-eligible whole replacement applies it, with deliberate geometry exception to sampled market trigger.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Mode can later change again; existing residual stays valued/harvested until real closure. No service restart just to observe new mode.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: False is not a physical residual shutdown or global pause. If left true after residual-only close, future eligible replacement may recreate it. Same-value setMode reverts; re-review geometry through same-value configureResidualSide if alreadyON.

actions.action: Close only the residual, keep main liquidity working
actions.inputs: Fresh ParkingRequest; lpTokenId is MAIN. minimum0/1 are only residual raw principal receipts, at least one positive.
actions.read_before: RESIDUAL_EXIT_VERSION1 on Migration/Vault/Manager/position child, both physical IDs, exact snapshot/hash/nonce/epoch, policy mode
actions.requirements: Sealed+paused, Active bucket with registered residual, no preparation/canonical/terminal lock. Reconcile pending jobs first.
actions.effect: Harvests both legs then burns only residual into same bucket idle. Main ID/ticks/L/centre/clock/shares/deposit stay unchanged. No swap, payout, compound release or implicit mode change.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Unpause after receipt and backing checks; principal remains attributed and can later be redeployed. Choose false mode first if future residuals unwanted.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: PoPL live work is briefly paused, but underlying main Uniswap LP still trades/earns if in range. Large returned idle can block entrants until guarded redeployment. A truly zero-rounded-principal residual cannot meet a positive raw min; whole merge/park remains a separate recovery path.

actions.action: Apply a normal whole replacement/merge at operator-chosen time
actions.caller: Any actually keeper-authorized wallet; governance alone is not enough
actions.inputs: Logical bucket, meaningful positive main raw-L minimum, now..now+600; native value zero.
actions.read_before: needsRebalance, rebalanceReady, rangeUpdatePending, current mode, cooldown, observations, live pricing/routes/limits, both physical LPs
actions.requirements: Live/unpaused, Active, no preparation/canonical/terminal locks. Raw/sample/manual geometry readiness and cooldown all as implemented.
actions.effect: Harvest, close both, release compound, at most one balancing swap, mint one or two per desired mode, enforce new active main and budgets, record actual new clock.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Subsequent guarded adjustment possible; current call atomic. Direct manual call bypasses only Python scheduling/jitter, not on-chain checks.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: No guaranteed exact inclusion time. Failed safety checks preserve old LP. A narrow selected route may be rejected even if another could work. Same-key manual submission requires journal/nonce reconciliation before worker resumes.

actions.action: Manual emergency consolidation/rebalance
actions.inputs: Exact emergency tuple below, fresh custodyHash, explicit aligned ticks and optional exact swap; positive meaningful main raw-L min; retained-check mask0..31; reviewHash.
actions.read_before: emergencyCustodyHash(bucket), Active/Parked custody/idle/compound/shares; tick spacing, actual post-withdrawal venue depth; mask-dependent prices/observations
actions.requirements: Sealed+paused, operating/preparation-free/canonical0, before terminal exit. This is never keeper automation or public fallback.
actions.effect: Closes both live legs (or uses Parked idle), optionally swaps exact specified amount and mints ONE main in CURRENT bucket pool. Does not run best-venue solver or create residual.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Stays paused; mode unchanged. Can later normal-adjust or park again. New actual clock/identity invalidates old sample readiness.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Optional financial/timing guards can all be bypassed only as expressly selected. This can lose nearly all principal or mint inactive LP. Fixed asset/custody/accounting/venue-code/lifecycle checks remain. No new LP destination field; cannot force cross-pool move.

actions.action: Invalidate an unexecuted raw parking/residual-close review
actions.inputs: Bucket ID only; nonpayable.
actions.read_before: parkingNonce(bucket), pending transaction/hash
actions.requirements: Before terminal exit, accounting operating; drain authority allows preparation context.
actions.effect: Increments shared parkingNonce so previously prepared park/closeResidual request fails.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: New snapshot/request can be prepared; nonce never decremented. Reconcile any already-broadcast request.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: It does not invalidate an EmergencyRebalance request by nonce; emergency has current custody snapshot+deadline, no separate explicit nonce. It does not cancel a mempool transaction or recover gas.

actions.action: Change trigger distance or residual-side geometry
actions.write: PortfolioPolicy.setTriggerBps(uint16 next,bytes32 reviewed); configureResidualSide(bytes32 pool,uint16 next,bytes32 reviewed)
actions.inputs: Trigger1..10000 of centre-to-boundary price distance; side1..10000 of corresponding main half-side, default5000. Nonzero review.
actions.read_before: thresholdBps, residualSideBps, enabled, mode/geometry revisions, actual tick spacing/main bounds, policy fingerprint
actions.requirements: Operating/pre-terminal. Side validates pool; global pause allowed.
actions.effect: Trigger revision resets samples but does not force a manual replacement. Side advances geometry when enabled and can intentionally re-review same value; desired physical change waits guarded replacement.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Configurable within hard bounds; on-chain config alone does not need process restart.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Extremely narrow side may have no representable tick interval. It never changes fixed main>=60/residual<=40 post-replacement constants. Neither parameter forces a continuously maintained market ratio.

actions.action: Select range price orientation / optional automatic widths
actions.write: Strategy.setRangeOrientation(bytes32 pool,uint8 orientation); setKeeperRangePolicy(bytes32 pool,bool enabled,uint16 narrow,uint16 widen,uint32 minInterval,bytes32 reviewHash)
actions.inputs: orientation0 raw pair or1 usualZZZ-inETH; changes must differ. Width policy enabling requires orientation1, current2500/5000, narrow<widen<2500, minInterval600..7d and>=pool cooldown, review.
actions.read_before: rangeOrientation, keeperRangePolicy, activeKeeperRangePolicies, requireReferenceExit, target bounds and full PoolConfig
actions.requirements: Operating; orientation and enabling need healthy pool/reference. Disable policy avoids old oracle/venue read. Enabling forbidden while requireReferenceExit=true.
actions.effect: Orientation changes planned geometry and disables automatic width policy. Automatic rules choose only±25/±50, not arbitrary keeper ranges or volatility inference.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Manual width remains via full configureNative; policy can be disabled and re-reviewed. No automatic transaction from setter.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Default fresh same-side reference protection and automatic widths are mutually exclusive: do not silently relax it. Reconfiguring other pool fields can make stored automatic configuration stale, requiring deliberate re-review.

actions.action: Change or stop sampled confirmation
actions.write: Confirmation.configure(uint32 secondsRequired,uint32 maximumGap,bytes32 reviewed); setRequireReferenceExit(bool required,bytes32 reviewed)
actions.inputs: Duration60..604800; maxGap<=duration/2;0 stops sampled ordinary readiness. Reference bool and nonzero review.
actions.read_before: duration,maxObservationGap,requireReferenceExit,policyRevision, activeKeeperRangePolicies, current observations and service cadence
actions.requirements: Operating/pre-terminal; enabling reference requirement requires no active automatic width policies.
actions.effect: Revisions invalidate samples. Reference=true requires physical and independent trigger same side for normal market conditions.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Configurable; worker cadence/inclusion must stay strictly within chosen maxgap. No journal reset.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: maxGap0 does not stop deliberate manual-geometry exception or governance emergency. It is not a global rebalance kill switch. Four-minute polling with maxgap300 is sampled evidence, not uninterrupted history.

actions.action: Record/reset ordinary confirmation observations
actions.inputs: Bucket ID; nonpayable. Reads return bool or event/reset reason.
actions.read_before: condition,observations,marketSides,needsRebalance,ready, exact source/runtime profile and pending receipt
actions.requirements: Observe live/unpaused, operating/preterminal; reset allowed while ordinary paused but operating/preterminal.
actions.effect: Record same-side identity/time sample or clear on fault/inside/manual/unconfigured. Reset never authorizes a trade.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Can restart sample window; do not recreate old evidence from off-chain timestamps. Calls consume gas and nonce.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Repeated direct calls from keeper key must be journaled/reconciled. Sending a transaction is not proof a sample was recorded; use authenticated receipt and chain state.

actions.action: Tune contribution/maintenance/additional-loss budgets
actions.write: Budget.setLossLimits(uint16 contribution,uint16 maintenance); Strategy.setAdditionalLossBps(uint16 limit,bytes32 reviewHash)
actions.inputs: Each0..1000bps. Defaults contribution200,maintenance300,additional100. Separate converter caps and venue gross limits also apply.
actions.read_before: Current getters, original caller minima, PoolConfig.maxSlippageBps, converter caps, quote fee and price bounds
actions.requirements: Operating lifecycle; Budget requires no armed snapshot. Pause allowed.
actions.effect: Changes future policy only; captured in-flight limits cannot be weakened by callback. Does not change economic split or previous credits.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Reconfigurable to ceilings; no automatic widening. Old prepared actions stale under changed policy.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Raising one cap does not relax every other floor. Gas separate; repeated permitted losses can accumulate. Additional fee-adjusted cap differs from gross operation cap and oracle agreement tolerance.

actions.action: Set compounding cooldown
actions.inputs: Admitted pool;600..604800seconds; default3600 absent override.
actions.read_before: compoundInterval, lastCompound(bucket), Position.lastRebalance, compoundReady, pending mode/range
actions.requirements: Operating, no armed snapshot; pause allowed.
actions.effect: Next standalone compound is after max(lastCompound,lastRebalance)+interval. Rebalance does not read lastCompound, so compound cannot delay urgent eligibility.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Reconfigurable, no clock rewrite/restart. Service in-range/threshold/pending-geometry wait is separate.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: No on-chain permanent compound-off switch specific to one job. Disable job/revoke keeper/disable pool operations for intended scope; zero interval is not allowed.

actions.action: Manage reviewed LP swap catalog and bounded solver
actions.write: Balancer.configureExecutionPools(bytes32[] pools,bytes32 reviewHash); configureSolver(uint8 iterations,uint32 gasLimit,bytes32 reviewHash)
actions.inputs: 0..4 unique admitted pool IDs; solver4..12passes and100000..300000gas per quote; nonzero review.
actions.read_before: executionPoolCount/At, executionRevision, pool accounting/fees/prices; searchIterations/quoteGasLimit; target depth AFTER LP withdrawal
actions.requirements: Operating/preterminal. Nonempty catalog admission validates healthy targets; empty removes all without external prices.
actions.effect: Separates swap venue from LP destination; one chosen swap only. Revision invalidates prepared contexts.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Can add a compatible future pool without Solidity edits; admission still via configureNative. Empty disables swaps without a fallback.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Finite search not global optimal guarantee. Removing a swap venue does not remove LP deployed there. Dense tick-crossing may exceed quote gas; raising cap does not authorize bad output or fix route-ranking liveness.

actions.action: Enable/disable ETH or fixedZZZ contribution source
actions.inputs: TokenETH0 or fixedZZZ; enabled policy pins current code/native sentinel and review; disabling reads no source dependency.
actions.read_before: zzz,activePolicy,policy, NATIVE_ASSET_CODE_HASH, token decimals/runtime and dual feed for enabling
actions.requirements: canConfigure; enabled only for fixed allowed contribution assets. Cannot bind anotherZZZ after seal.
actions.effect: Controls new contributions, not existing LP valuations, reward claims or royalty currencies.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Re-enable with fresh validation; reconfiguring pool cannot override disabled source.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Pair prices still needed forETH andZZZ regardless input. No adding USDC/USDG/WETH user input or changing token by ticker.

actions.action: Manage Entry conversion routes
actions.inputs: Exact typed immutable v3/v4 route structs with addresses/PoolKey/runtime hashes/review, then returned routeId. Enable/disable bool.
actions.read_before: routeKind/route/routeEnabled, source/output policy, native pool pair, factory/router/core pins; fresh full activation preparation
actions.requirements: Operating and nonreentrant; enabling validates route. Only fixedETH/ZZZ source inputs.
actions.effect: Routes new input conversion only; LP custody destination and balancing catalog remain separate.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Disable old route and add/review new ID. Append-only identity; no arbitrary router calldata or third input.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Approvals exact raw source amount. Direct pair currency uses routeId0 as appropriate; route admission is not depth/feed/production qualification.

actions.action: Manual independent harvesting
actions.inputs: Active logical bucket; deadline now..now+600; nonpayable.
actions.read_before: group, both actual IDs, fee reserve balances and funded claims; canonical receipt and FeesCollected
actions.requirements: Sealed live/unpaused, active, before terminal/canonical lock. No rebalance price trigger/cooldown required.
actions.effect: Collects actual fee receipts from both legs and applies80/10/5/5 once. No balancing swap, compounding or buyback.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Repeat later only for new actual fees; keeper hourly setting is off-chain not a contract clock.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Global pause blocks external collectFees, though internal harvest during authorized paused close is allowed. LP venue/token/ledger health remains required. Claims need not wait for a rebalance once harvesting occurs.

actions.action: Manual compounding into current main
actions.inputs: Bucket; meaningful positive raw MAIN L minimum; fresh deadline.
actions.read_before: Budget.compoundReady, independent interval, group/idle/compound reserves, keeper in-range/threshold/pending geometry policy
actions.requirements: Live/unpaused, operating, active beforeterminal; Budget cooldown/need guards. User-approved stronger in-range wait is service policy, not an absolute separate on-chain ban.
actions.effect: Harvest both, release designated reserves, optional guarded swap, INCREASE main only; residual identity/L unchanged.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: No withdrawal to operator; future harvest/compound/rebalance remain separate. Reconciled receipt updates compound clock.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Changing governance desired mode/range can make this unavailable; do not use manual compound to evade intended outside/threshold protection. Large attributed idle may require whole guarded adjustment.

actions.action: Stop/tune/manual execute buyback and burn
actions.write: Buyback.setOperatingTradeUSD(uint256 limit); execute(address token,uint256 amount,bytes32 pool,uint256 deadline)
actions.inputs: Limit USD18 within immutable maxTradeUSD;0stops. Execute exact reserve token/raw amount, admitted swap pool or unused when burningZZZ, fresh deadline.
actions.read_before: operatingTradeUSD,maxTradeUSD,fixedzzz,Fees.buybackBalance,upper input price, actual swap floor/output, totalSupply before/after
actions.requirements: Execute live/unpaused+operating; reserve-only works after terminal completion when qualified routes admitted. Setter allowed paused.
actions.effect: ZZZ reserve burns directly using burn() and verifies supply decrease;ETH reserve swaps intoZZZ then burns. Not sent to a dead address and not triggered by claim.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Limit reversible within immutable ceiling; burned supply cannot be restored. No sweep of holders/principal.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Price outage can block even directZZZ burn due trade budget pricing. Disabled last venue can be re-admitted after exitReady with deposits=false; principal never reopens.

actions.action: Stop/restart/configure reward conversion
actions.write: LPConverter and RoyaltyConverter: setEnabled(bool); setConversionLossBps(uint16); addRoute/addV4Route/setRouteEnabled; configureWrapper(WrapperPolicy)
actions.inputs: Each ledger has separate bound converter. Cap0..1000bps(default100); typed route/hash policy; wrapper fixed at deployment and only reviewed if used.
actions.read_before: converter.ledger/access/enabled/loss/route getters, runtime and proxy/admin pins, actual input/output and prices
actions.requirements: Operating; pause allowed for setters. Executing convert requires live and bound ledger only.
actions.effect: Controls conversion of already earned balances; source entitlement stays backed on failure. No holder/principal rights reassignment.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Enable/disable and routes configurable; converter/wrapper implementation binding fixed after seal. Native v4 route does not need unused wrapper.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Source-only claims remain possible if currency itself works. NativeETH already credited needs no conversion. A global converter stop does not stop harvest or source claims.

actions.action: Manual batch LP/royalty conversion
actions.inputs: Non-native admitted source;1..32strictly increasing IDs; correct route ID; positive raw minimumETH and deadline.
actions.read_before: Per-ID raw claimable source, converter config, current owners/royalty weights, pending receipts, output floor, raw backing
actions.requirements: Live/unpaused, operating, selected ledger current/bound converter; no terminal principal reopen.
actions.effect: Checkpoint selected already-earned whole balances, aggregate swap once, assignETH to SAME IDs/components by cumulative rounding; no new-income event or membership redistribution.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Atomic failure leaves source credits unchanged. Holders later claimETH or permitted direct source currency.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Cannot fabricateETH display while conversion pending; fractions stay in source. Required route/feed/token failure remains unavailable; select independent batch/route rather than silently widening cap.

actions.action: Admit/recover royalty currencies
actions.write: NFT.addRoyaltyAsset(address token); RoyaltyRewards.sync(address asset), syncAll(), fund(asset,amount)
actions.inputs: Actual conventional ERC20 currency; maximum16ERC20+native. sync asset must be admitted. fund requires exact approved raw token amount.
actions.read_before: assetCount/assets,isAsset,pending/accounted,eligibleFor,eligibleCount/weight, deferred joins and source token behavior
actions.requirements: Economic canonical state; ordinary pause does not prohibit sync/claims. Admission wrapper governance canConfigure; no contribution-token expansion.
actions.effect: Pre-admission raw balances quarantined. Recovery assigns previously unseen receipts to earlier eligible cohort before joining waiting activations.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Cannot remove an admitted currency or redistribute prior quarantine using a setter. Per-asset sync can recover healthy currencies without syncAll.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: syncAll/canonical backing can fail on one unreadable token; activation has gas-isolated optional synchronization. Unknown marketplace currency cannot be assumedETH or converted before explicit reviewed admission.

actions.action: Holder claims and recovery when receiver rejects
actions.caller: Actual current NFT owner; fixed router authenticates owner
actions.inputs: Full NFT ID, raw asset identity; up to32tuples(id,asset,royalty), no duplicates or arbitrary payout target.
actions.read_before: ownerOf,claimable,funded raw balances,currency availability and canonical state
actions.requirements: Sealed canonical-operating lifecycle; ordinary pause and terminal principal exit do not disable earned claims.
actions.effect: Pays owner and reduces liabilities once; old unclaimed rights follow transfers. No harvest/compound/burn side effect.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Claim final; failures atomic. Split failing currency or retry after recovery; no administrator claim-for-holder backdoor.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Rejecting owner contract can reject its payout. A change of owner transfers unpaid rights; the operator cannot select a different recipient in reward claims.

actions.action: Metadata refresh, ordered reveal and permanent art configuration
actions.caller: Refresh/finalize permissionless; baseURI governance preseal once
actions.inputs: Full valid NFT ID; range bounded as callable contract; reveal exactly nextToFinalize; nonempty reviewed ipfs/ar URI only when unset.
actions.read_before: traitsReady,nextToFinalize,requestOf/epoch/fulfillment,currentLPValue/evolution,tokenURI,artworkBaseURI
actions.requirements: Refresh requires owned token; finalize canonicalAccounting and fulfilled next mint order. Existing URI fixed after configured/sealed.
actions.effect: Refresh emits ERC4906, does not change principal or force marketplace cache. Reveal uses prior authenticated words without reroll.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Successful reveal/base is immutable. Missing earlier fulfillment blocks later ordered reveals and canonical replacement.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: No max URI byte length exists; actual immutable payload and storage/provider hosting must be qualified. Refresh does not repair a broken price feed; USD metadata can remain unavailable.

actions.action: Tune future randomness request settings / provider recovery boundary
actions.inputs: Confirmations3..200; callbackGas200000..10000000. Coordinator/lane/subscription/payment mode immutable after initial preseal configureRandomness.
actions.read_before: randomnessConfigured/coordinator,keyHash,subscriptionId,nativePayment, future request parameters, pending fulfilled words
actions.requirements: Operating; pause allowed. Only future requests change.
actions.effect: Tunes request cost/finality/gas, never retries/replaces pending request or selects artwork.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Reconfigurable future settings, no restart requirement solely onchain; provider subscription funding/consumer permissions are external operations.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: No admin reroll or provider replacement after seal. Stop minting on provider outage, fund/fix original provider if possible. Unsupported provider or permanent unanswered request remains a release/longevity risk.

actions.action: Rotate governance and limited automation permissions
actions.caller: Governance proposes/grants; exact pending candidate accepts; bootstrap configuration beforeseal
actions.inputs: Nonzero authorized keeper/guardian; governance candidate zero cancels, cannot self/current address. Actual wallet/Safe execution must make msg.sender match.
actions.read_before: governance,pendingGovernance,keepers/guardians,canConfigure,preparation/canonical status, active/pending signer work
actions.requirements: Governance rotation normal canonical/preparation-free. Role configuration uses canConfigure and can occur paused.
actions.effect: Two-step key rotation prevents typo handover; keeper grants limited operations, guardian only emergency pause.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Revoke/replace after reconciling pending work; keeper host state/key migration is separate. No second human role required.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Revocation does not cancel a broadcast transaction (it may revert at inclusion). Lost governance with no recoverable wallet/Safe keys has no protocol admin override; sealing eliminates bootstrap authority.

A new down/recovering sequencer remains unusable until healthy beyond one-hour grace; zero cannot remove that safeguard. Token precision/implementation failure cannot be fixed by inventing a price. actions.action: Handle accidental unsupported assets, failed reserves and immutable mint receiver
actions.write: No generic sweep/recovery/recipient replacement function; use existing typed claims/conversions/burn/park/holder return/canonical path as applicable
actions.inputs: Identify actual raw asset address, receipt provenance and correct ledger/classification before selecting a typed operation. Never treat raw balance as owed fee/principal by itself.

actions.requirements: No permission grants arbitrary transfer, write-index, earned reward sweep or previously unsupported royalty redistribution. Recovery depends on actual asset/token/receiver functioning.
actions.effect: Preserves all classified backing; unadmitted receipts/donations are not newly earned income. Existing typed reserve conversions cannot spend holder principal or unrelated raw prefunds.
actions.reversibility_and_restart: Unsupported donations or irreducible index rounding may remain reserved/unrecoverable rather than redistributed. A rejecting immutable mint-payment recipient blocks new mint atomically; it cannot be changed through configuration after seal.
actions.edge_cases_and_fallback: Do not add a sweep simply to clear displayed dust. Governance key loss, permanently broken tokens/core, disappeared home chain or unavailable originalVRF have explicit recovery limits; current contracts provide no universal rescue override.

No existing production payload builder for complex park/residual/emergency requests was found in scripts/script/keeper/indexer; test tuples are fixtures, not operator tools.

operator_gaps_and_boundaries.description: No per-leg pause of trading/fees. Main and residual are two position NFTs in one Uniswap pool, not two independently stoppable pools. PoPL global pause does not control external swaps. Removing residual keeps main onchain; closing main alone while retaining residual is not an exposed action.

Safe pool-move order must reserve target to EXISTING bucket before enabling target deposits. Configure target deposits=false/ops=true, reservePool(target,existingBucket), stop old deposits, perform live guarded move, then enable target deposits. Concurrent early activation can create an incompatible permanent target bucket; no bucket merge/reassign path.

Complex ParkingRequest/EmergencyRebalance manifests have no maintained read-only payload builder found. Exact tuple fields/read provenance/reviewHash and simulation must be documented; do not claim one-click generation. A safe unsigned builder is a justified future enhancement, not silently implemented here.

maxGap0 stops sampled market readiness but manual geometry exception remains; empty venues stops swaps not natural no-swap operations; source disable affects contributions not preexisting LP; keeper job stop is offchain and not a revoked onchain capability.

Residual close returns large attributed idle without changing shares. Entrants cannot finance recovery and may be blocked by5%idle cap; use guarded redeploy/merge/qualified compound or explicit emergency. No administrator dust/principal/royalty sweep or arbitrary recipient exists.

Emergency requests have custodyHash/deadline rather than parkingNonce. invalidateParking invalidates park/residual-close only. Stop/reconcile actual pending emergency transaction; short deadline/fresh immutable snapshot is not a general mempool cancel function.

Raw park/residual/terminal close avoidUSDprices/swaps but still require actual token/core/native bindings and fees/backing ledger behavior. Emergency optional checks do not bypass broken upstream contracts, fixed token/core identities or terminal locks.

Token issuer migration, different actual LP pair, replacement algorithms/implementation, mutable VRF provider, larger immutable buyback ceiling and primary OpenSea drop integration are not routine config edits. Fixed currentZZZ and terminal holder return+redeployment decisions remain. Same-chain canonical handoff is separate and before terminal exit.

No automatic guarantee for every contract holder: isolated principal payouts preserve backing on recipient failure, with retry/new-owner/actual-owner fallback. Operator cannot redirect to an arbitrary beneficiary; earned reward claims have current-owner auth too.

Lost sole governance authority has no protocol override. Use recoverable wallet/Safe custody and two-step rotation; revoking keeper/guardian does not cancel already-broadcast work. Pending journals, credentials and server failover must be reconciled independently from onchain policy.
